source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of writing files (PDF 62).

blocks.text: File mein likhne ke liye usay write mode ("w") mein kholein aur write() method istemal karein. Purane data ke baad mazeed jorna ho to append mode ("a") istemal karein.

#    Writing to a file
with open("example.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!\n")
#    Appending to a file
with open("example.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write("Appending new line.\n")

items: "w" mode file ka purana mawaad mita kar naya likhta hai (file na ho to bana deta hai).
"a" mode purana mawaad rakh kar naya data aakhir mein jorta hai. \n ka matlab nayi line hai.

blocks.prompt: Dono blocks chalne ke baad example.txt mein kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Do lines: "As-Salaam-Alaikum, World!" aur "Appending new line."

items: "w": mita kar likho; "a": aakhir mein joro.
